extDesc.message: Displays a reading line at your cursor to help you keep your place and reduce line skipping.

onboardingBody.message: Open the page you want to read, then select On to show the reading line at your cursor.

onboardingHint.message: If you are unsure, start with the default settings.

onboardingAction.message: Check the color and thickness, then select On to start. Once it appears, use Shift+Alt+Up/Down to move the line.

labelAutoOn.message: Turn on automatically for this site

trialRemainingOne.message: $DAYS$ day left in your free trial

trialRemainingMany.message: $DAYS$ days left in your free trial

statusFirstUseEmpty.message: No reading line is showing yet. Open a page to read, then select On to start.

statusLineShown.message: Reading line shown. Use Shift+Alt+Up/Down to move it with the keyboard.

statusUnavailable.message: The reading line cannot be used on this page
